exposure: Weeks of pregnancy at data collection
outcome: Small for gestational age (SGA) at birth
cohort: The study included 20 cases of small for gestational age (SGA) births and 65 control cases.
finding: Associations were detected between lower maternal serum PlGF and Visfatin levels, an increased sFlt-1/PlGF ratio, and smoking status with small for gestational age (SGA) at birth.
cross-section timing: Maternal serum measurements were taken at 11-13 weeks gestation.
